questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 1)
questions.context: When ocean temperatures rise by even one or two degrees for several weeks, corals expel the algae that live in their tissues and give them both colour and most of their food. The reef turns white, a condition known as bleaching. Corals can recover if the water cools quickly, but repeated episodes leave them starved and vulnerable to disease, and some reefs have lost half their living cover within a decade.
options: Algae as a source of food for fish
Recovery of corals in cool water
How rising sea temperatures starve corals
questions.answer: How rising sea temperatures starve corals
questions.why: Đoạn nói nhiệt độ tăng khiến san hô mất tảo và đói dần. Các lựa chọn khác quá rộng, quá hẹp hoặc chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 2)
questions.context: Before the introduction of the uniform penny post in Britain in 1840, the cost of sending a letter depended on distance and the number of sheets, and was paid by the recipient. Many people refused delivery, having read the outside of the envelope for news. Rowland Hill's reform replaced this with a flat prepaid charge, and the volume of letters roughly doubled within two years.
options: The invention of the adhesive stamp
A pricing reform that transformed letter writing
The history of communication in Britain
questions.answer: A pricing reform that transformed letter writing
questions.why: Ý chính là cải cách giá cước làm thư tăng gấp đôi. Việc từ chối nhận thư chỉ là chi tiết phụ; tem dán không được nhắc.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 3)
questions.context: Streets lined with mature trees can be several degrees cooler than treeless ones on a hot afternoon. Leaves block sunlight and release water vapour, which cools the air much as sweat cools skin. Studies of cities in Europe and Asia suggest that planting trees is among the cheapest ways to reduce heat-related illness, though young trees need years of watering before they provide meaningful shade.
options: The best species to plant in European cities
Why young trees need frequent watering
Trees as a low-cost way of cooling cities
How sweating cools the human body
The role of parks in city planning
questions.answer: Trees as a low-cost way of cooling cities
questions.why: Cả đoạn bàn về cây xanh làm mát đô thị với chi phí thấp. Mồ hôi chỉ là phép so sánh, việc tưới cây là ý phụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 4)
questions.context: Sourdough bread relies on a starter, a mixture of flour and water in which wild yeasts and bacteria live together. The bacteria produce acids that give the loaf its tang and slow the growth of mould, while the yeasts make gas that lifts the dough. Because every starter harbours its own mix of microbes, bakeries often claim their bread cannot be duplicated elsewhere.
options: How to maintain a flour starter at home
questions.answer: The microbial partnership behind sourdough
questions.why: Đoạn giải thích men và vi khuẩn phối hợp tạo ra bánh. Các tiêu đề khác sai trọng tâm hoặc không được bàn tới.
questions.quote: wild yeasts and bacteria live together

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 5)
questions.context: Arctic terns travel from the northern polar region to Antarctic waters and back each year, a round trip that can exceed seventy thousand kilometres. Scientists once thought the birds followed the coast, but tiny tracking devices have shown that they take winding routes that follow prevailing winds, saving energy even though the distance is longer. The tracking results have changed how researchers view long-distance migration.
options: The dangers faced by polar wildlife
The record distance flown by a single bird
Tracking evidence that overturns assumptions about a bird's route
questions.answer: Tracking evidence that overturns assumptions about a bird's route
questions.why: Trọng tâm là dữ liệu theo dõi cho thấy tuyến đường khác với giả định. Quãng đường chỉ là chi tiết, còn lý do di cư không được bàn.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 6)
questions.context: Each time antibiotics are used, a few bacteria may survive because of chance mutations. These survivors multiply, and the next course of treatment faces a tougher population. Overuse in hospitals and in farming speeds this process, and doctors warn that routine surgery could become dangerous again if common infections can no longer be treated. New drugs are being developed, but few companies find them profitable.
options: The discovery of the first antibiotic
The profits of the pharmaceutical industry
How overuse of drugs breeds untreatable infections
questions.answer: How overuse of drugs breeds untreatable infections
questions.why: Ý chính là lạm dụng kháng sinh tạo ra vi khuẩn kháng thuốc. Lợi nhuận hãng thuốc và phẫu thuật chỉ là ý phụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 7)
questions.context: Papyrus, made from the stems of a riverside reed, was the main writing material of the ancient Mediterranean world for over three thousand years. Strips of the pith were laid crosswise, pressed and dried into sheets, which were then joined into long rolls. Although fragile in damp conditions, papyrus survives well in dry climates, which is why most surviving examples come from Egypt.
options: The decline of reed-growing in Egypt
Making and preserving the writing material of the ancient world
Modern attempts to recreate ancient crafts
questions.answer: Making and preserving the writing material of the ancient world
questions.why: Đoạn nói cách làm giấy cói và vì sao nó còn tồn tại. Độ mong manh chỉ là một chi tiết nhỏ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 8)
questions.context: Inflation is a general rise in prices over time, and moderate amounts are generally seen as healthy because they encourage spending and investment. Problems arise when prices rise faster than wages, since households can then afford less. Central banks respond by raising interest rates, which makes borrowing more expensive and slows demand, though this can also increase unemployment.
options: Managing price rises: costs and trade-offs
The benefits of moderate wage growth
questions.answer: Managing price rises: costs and trade-offs
questions.why: Đoạn bàn về lạm phát và cách ngân hàng trung ương cân bằng được mất. Thất nghiệp và lãi suất chỉ xuất hiện như một phần.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 9)
questions.context: The method of loci asks learners to imagine walking through a familiar place and to leave vivid images of items at fixed points along the route. To recall the list, they simply walk the route again. Memory champions use the technique to memorise thousands of digits, and experiments show that ordinary volunteers can double their recall after a few weeks of practice.
options: A visual technique that dramatically improves recall
Why some people have better memories than others
Digits and numbers in everyday life
Problems with mnemonic devices in schools
questions.answer: A visual technique that dramatically improves recall
questions.why: Đoạn mô tả kỹ thuật hình dung lộ trình để nhớ tốt hơn. Các lựa chọn khác chỉ trùng từ khoá hoặc không được nhắc.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 10)
questions.context: The Atacama in northern Chile is often called the driest place on Earth, with some weather stations recording no rain for years. Yet it is not lifeless. Fog drifting in from the Pacific condenses on cactus spines and specially adapted plants, and microbes live beneath the surface of rocks. NASA tests equipment there because the soil resembles that of Mars.
options: The Pacific Ocean's influence on fog
Life and research in an extremely dry region
questions.answer: Life and research in an extremely dry region
questions.why: Đoạn kết hợp sự sống ở sa mạc và việc NASA thử nghiệm. Mỗi lựa chọn khác chỉ nắm một chi tiết hoặc quá rộng.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 11)
questions.context: Tall buildings only became practical after Elisha Otis demonstrated a safety brake for lifts in 1854. Before then, passengers feared that a broken rope would send the cabin crashing down. The brake held the cabin in place if the rope failed, and within decades builders were erecting offices of ten, twenty, then more than forty floors.
options: The tallest buildings in the world
A safety invention that made tall buildings possible
How offices changed in the twentieth century
questions.answer: A safety invention that made tall buildings possible
questions.why: Phát minh phanh an toàn là nguyên nhân giúp nhà cao tầng khả thi. Nguy hiểm thang máy chỉ là bối cảnh.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 12)
questions.context: English has borrowed words from so many sources that perhaps three quarters of its vocabulary is of foreign origin. After the Norman conquest of 1066, French became the language of law and government, giving English words such as judge and court, while the common people kept words like cow and sheep. Later trade and empire added vocabulary from Arabic, Hindi and dozens of other languages.
options: The Norman conquest and its political effects
Words used in courts of law
The many outside sources of English vocabulary
The spread of English around the world
questions.answer: The many outside sources of English vocabulary
questions.why: Đoạn liệt kê nhiều nguồn vay mượn từ vựng. Cuộc chinh phục Norman chỉ là một ví dụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 13)
questions.context: Regular brisk walking for thirty minutes a day is associated with lower risk of heart disease, diabetes and depression. It requires no equipment, carries little risk of injury and suits people of almost all ages. Some doctors now prescribe walking groups, noting that the social contact may add to the benefits. Evidence that ten thousand steps is a magic target is weak, however.
options: The accessible health benefits of daily walking
Why ten thousand steps is the ideal target
questions.answer: The accessible health benefits of daily walking
questions.why: Ý chính là lợi ích dễ tiếp cận của đi bộ. Mốc mười nghìn bước bị bài bác nên không thể là tiêu đề.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 14)
questions.context: The satellite navigation system used by phones and cars depends on extremely precise clocks. Each satellite broadcasts its position and the time of the signal, and a receiver calculates its distance from at least four satellites to fix its location. Because the satellites move fast and sit high above Earth's gravity, engineers must correct for small relativistic effects; otherwise errors would grow by several kilometres a day.
options: The timing principles that allow satellite positioning
questions.answer: The timing principles that allow satellite positioning
questions.why: Đoạn giải thích vai trò của đồng hồ chính xác trong định vị. Thuyết tương đối chỉ xuất hiện như bước hiệu chỉnh.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 15)
questions.context: People who volunteer regularly report greater satisfaction with life, and some studies find they live longer than non-volunteers. Critics note that healthier, more sociable people may be more likely to volunteer in the first place. Experiments that randomly assign people to volunteering schemes are rare, but the few that exist suggest that the benefit is real for older adults, especially when the work involves contact with others.
options: The kinds of charities people prefer
Is volunteering good for the volunteer? The evidence
questions.answer: Is volunteering good for the volunteer? The evidence
questions.why: Đoạn xem xét bằng chứng về lợi ích của việc làm tình nguyện cho chính người làm. Các lựa chọn khác lạc đề hoặc chỉ là chi tiết.
questions.quote: the benefit is real for older adults

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 16)
questions.context: Before Gutenberg's press appeared around 1450, books were copied by hand and cost as much as a house in some cases. Movable metal type allowed printers to produce hundreds of identical copies, and the price of books fell sharply. Within fifty years, millions of volumes had been printed across Europe, and ideas, from religious reform to scientific discoveries, spread faster than any authority could control.
options: How cheap printing accelerated the spread of ideas
questions.answer: How cheap printing accelerated the spread of ideas
questions.why: Trọng tâm là sách rẻ giúp ý tưởng lan nhanh. Cải cách tôn giáo và kim loại chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 17)
questions.context: Although plastic bottles carry recycling symbols, only a small fraction of all plastic ever made has been recycled. Different types melt at different temperatures and cannot be mixed, and food residue contaminates batches. Sorting by hand is slow and expensive, and new plastic is often cheaper than recycled. Researchers are therefore developing enzymes that break plastic back into its original chemicals.
options: The cost of household waste collection
The practical obstacles to recycling plastic
questions.answer: The practical obstacles to recycling plastic
questions.why: Phần lớn đoạn nêu các trở ngại thực tế khi tái chế. Enzyme chỉ là giải pháp nhắc ở cuối.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 18)
questions.context: When a honeybee finds a rich source of nectar, it returns to the hive and performs a waggle dance. The angle of the dance relative to vertical shows the direction of the food in relation to the sun, and the length of the waggle shows the distance. Other workers decode the message and fly straight to the flowers. The discovery earned the Austrian scientist Karl von Frisch a Nobel Prize in 1973.
options: The prize-winning career of Karl von Frisch
The role of the sun in navigation
A dance language that guides bees to food
questions.answer: A dance language that guides bees to food
questions.why: Ý chính là điệu nhảy truyền thông tin về thức ăn. Giải Nobel và mặt trời chỉ là ý phụ.
questions.quote: the length of the waggle shows the distance

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 19)
questions.context: Research on homework suggests that its value depends on age. For secondary students, moderate amounts are linked to better results, but for primary pupils the benefit is small and may be outweighed by stress and lost family time. Many schools are therefore rethinking the practice, replacing worksheets with reading or short projects, though parents often resist, fearing that their children will fall behind.
options: Changing views on the value of homework
questions.answer: Changing views on the value of homework
questions.why: Đoạn nói quan điểm về bài tập về nhà đang thay đổi. Các lựa chọn khác quá hẹp hoặc không được bàn.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for this paragraph. (Paragraph 20)
questions.context: Several cities have begun replacing diesel buses with electric ones. The vehicles are quieter and produce no exhaust where people breathe, which improves street air quality. Their main drawbacks are cost, since a battery bus can be double the price, and charging time. However, lower running costs mean the extra investment is repaid within about eight years, according to some transport agencies.
options: Weighing the costs and benefits of electric buses
questions.answer: Weighing the costs and benefits of electric buses
questions.why: Đoạn cân nhắc ưu và nhược điểm xe buýt điện. Chất lượng không khí chỉ là một lợi ích, không phải cả đoạn.
